scenes.title: A Power Platform meeting, with useful answers close at hand
scenes.caption: Fictional scenario: field service, approvals, analytics, customer portals and an agent.

scenes.title: Three independent languages. All English for this tour.
scenes.caption: Listening: English (en-US). Analysis: English. Display: English. Settings stay off the workspace.

scenes.title: Configure Azure Speech with an organizational identity
scenes.caption: Endpoint, tenant, application client ID and audio consent; no resource key. Values shown are placeholders.

scenes.title: Or explicitly select Whisper offline recognition
scenes.caption: Local speech and speaker models are provisioned ahead of time. Work IQ remains a separate online service.

scenes.title: Hear both sides through shared-mode audio
scenes.caption: Choose microphone, system audio or both; match Teams devices, refresh endpoints and review privacy.

scenes.title: Set context and answer style without taking workspace height
scenes.caption: Automatic analysis is enabled. Audio storage is off; readable conversation JSON stays on this PC.

scenes.title: Sign in once; keep service credentials separate
scenes.caption: Simulated sign-in only. Speech uses Entra authorization; Work IQ uses its own account-bound CLI session.

scenes.title: Start Conversation
scenes.caption: English recognition begins; no question is sent just because speech is detected.

scenes.title: Capture the Power Apps and automation requirements
scenes.caption: Final transcript cards retain speaker labels; partial speech stays separate until finalized.

scenes.title: Keep listening while the scenario gets richer
scenes.caption: Power BI, Power Pages and Copilot Studio enter the same conversation.

scenes.title: Seven final utterances trigger automatic analysis
scenes.caption: The complete conversation supports overall intent; the current stage provides focused new context.

scenes.title: Group and rename the licensing discussion
scenes.caption: Create a transcript group, collapse or expand it, then rename it or analyze only that group.

scenes.title: Intent: understand the decision, not just the words
scenes.caption: The whole conversation informs goals, constraints and open decisions. Unsupported assumptions stay explicit.

scenes.title: Stage summaries build a useful meeting history
scenes.caption: Each successful analysis appends only new stage content. Select earlier analyses without sending a request.

scenes.title: Difficult questions. Simple, clickable wording.
scenes.caption: Recommend hard-to-remember rules and tradeoffs. Keep background in hover details, not long question labels.

scenes.title: Hover for context; click for a reference answer
scenes.caption: A click asks Work IQ. A right-click fills the question box so the user can edit before asking.

scenes.title: Product guide: Power Apps and Dataverse
scenes.caption: Only conversation-relevant facts. Licensing and limitations are tables, without a reference-link appendix.

scenes.title: Product guide: Power Automate
scenes.caption: Separate user eligibility, flow ownership, connector dependencies and capacity assumptions.

scenes.title: Product guide: Power BI
scenes.caption: Show sharing prerequisites and capacity choices as conditions to verify, not an unconditional promise.

scenes.title: Product guide: Power Pages
scenes.caption: External identities, access scope and usage inputs belong beside the cost model.

scenes.title: Product guide: Copilot Studio
scenes.caption: Agent actions, data boundaries and consumption assumptions are relevant to this customer scenario.

scenes.title: Ask the selected question while listening continues
scenes.caption: Questions and answers have their own history. The conversation does not stop for Work IQ.

scenes.title: Expand the answer panel for the detail that matters
scenes.caption: Read the conclusion, a small comparison table and concrete next checks; copy, retry or dismiss locally.

scenes.title: Inspect the original answer, then return to rich view
scenes.caption: Raw Markdown remains available when needed. Copy Answer preserves the response text.

scenes.title: Edit a recommendation or ask manually
scenes.caption: Right-click a question or transcript card to prefill the question box. Ctrl+Enter submits the edited request.

scenes.title: Malformed analysis? Recover automatically.
scenes.caption: Illustrated internal flow: retry schema validation up to three attempts. No partial analysis is committed.

scenes.title: Recovery succeeds without asking the user to reanalyze
scenes.caption: Only a validated result updates intent, stage summaries, recommendations and product guides.

scenes.title: Pause listening without losing the workspace
scenes.caption: Existing transcripts, analyses and answers remain available. Recognition settings can now be changed.

scenes.title: Resume listening in English
scenes.caption: Audio sources reopen with the selected devices. Analysis and display languages remain English.

scenes.title: Save the conversation as readable JSON
scenes.caption: Transcripts, groups, analysis, product guides and replies are retained. No audio or credentials are saved.

scenes.title: End the conversation; keep the reference workspace
scenes.caption: End stops capture but leaves the conversation visible. Copy, inspect or export the saved results.

scenes.title: Import a record without restarting listening or Work IQ
scenes.caption: A saved JSON record opens as a separate local copy. Inspect history, then explicitly ask for new analysis.

scenes.title: Less configuration chrome. More room for the conversation.
scenes.caption: English throughout. Power Platform scenario. Simulated UI and responses; no live service calls or real quotes.
